title: Clinical delineation, sex differences, and genotype-phenotype correlation in pathogenic KDM6A variants causing X-linked Kabuki syndrome type 2

reviewer.method: Personally read the complete 780-line, nine-page main article including references/back matter; original cover identity, all three figures and both tables in page pixels; both pages of the supplementary PDF; all 80 clinical rows and all 69 columns, headers/abbreviation footer of S1; all 252 Counts formulas and stored results; every populated Measurement cell; all 16 PAV rows, multilevel headings and footnotes in S2. Inspected complete worksheet structure, styles, merges, hidden-state and chart XML; read all 12 chart series, category labels and axes, then the entire native chart rendered headlessly from a separate print-only workbook copy. Original workbooks unchanged. Read all three assigned packets including alternate, all alleles and all 92 phenotype assertions; inspected all three transposed case-row pages. Parent/predecessor preparation is attributed as preparation, not personal reading. No browser/native UI or target-case outcomes consulted.

audit.exposure_note: Required HANDOFF reading exposed aggregate history and a historical public-control HG002/FGFR2 case-specific rank. No target-case inference ranks, inference-output files or benchmark outcome summaries consulted. This review is not blinded.
